info.album: Sealed with a Kiss and All the Great Hits, 1960 - 1962

podcast.body: Bryan Hyland had a hit with "Sealed With A Kiss" in 1962. This song was later covered by The Surf Punks on their 1982 album `Locals Only`. "including this version of the 1962 Bryan Highland hit, Sealed With A Kiss."
